acceptanceCriteria: A crashed owner between dispatch and FINISHED no longer strands the attempt: either a combined attempt+program transition or a takeover rule admits a bound, stopped, quiescent attempt, and an unproved stop still fails closed.
TestCALV0074_NoExecCrashTakeover is updated to cover the recovery and the retained refusal; the noExec WAITING settlement is either cancelled or documented as intended.
body: Known limit retained by V1-0755 (Claude Code supervised host, issue 354, review round r5; lane branch claude/v1-0755-claude-code-host). If the program owner process dies after dispatch and before it writes the FINISHED record, the program stays SPAWNING or STOPPING. The attempt keeps its claim and reservation, and a replacement owner is refused at internal/tasks/transaction/program.go:106 with "prior program owner not proved stopped". Witness: TestCALV0074_NoExecCrashTakeover/stopped in internal/tasks/store/program_claude_host_test.go, which pins the current refusal. Related observation: non-cancelling noExec paths settle the attempt to WAITING without cancelling it. Expected: a crashed owner's attempt can be recovered without manual store surgery, still failing closed when stop is not proved. Actual: the attempt stays held until its lease expires or the owner intervenes manually. Candidate fixes (an owner design choice): a combined attempt+program transition, or a takeover rule that admits a bound, stopped, quiescent attempt from STOPPING.

completion.reason: Merged via beamfall/corvint#710 (e5298bc5): crashed-owner takeover admits a bound, stopped, quiescent attempt and an unproved stop still refuses (ATTEMPT_LIVE); TestCALV0074_NoExecCrashTakeover covers four crash points and fails on base. CAL-V0-210 accepted by decision 0473. Live qualification NOT_RUN.

title: tasks: owner crash between dispatch and FINISHED leaves a supervised program SPAWNING/STOPPING and blocks takeover
